checks.name: Six drag handles replace all arrow controls
Desktop drag updates draft and live preview; save persists reload
Cancel discards drag order and visibility together
Keyboard works through the same handle; Escape restores; Space commits
Pointer Escape and cancellation restore order without saving
Drag returns to original order clears unsaved state
Desktop/mobile/light/dark captures have full labels and no overflow
Real emulated touch drag reorders and releases capture
